name: Enemy

lessons.title: Creating the Enemy Component
lessons.summary: A minor enemy beside the hero
concepts: BonfireWidget's list for all but the player

lessons.title: Apply Behavior
concepts: Runs a list of behaviors every frame
If this, do that; otherwise, do something else
Wander at random when no one is near

lessons.title: Apply Lifebar
lessons.summary: Life and a bar over each character
concepts: Draws a life bar over a character
How much damage a character can take

lessons.title: Respond to Hurt
concepts: Runs once the component joins the game
Calls you back on every hit
Plays the hurt animation one time

lessons.title: Respond to Die
concepts: Calls you back when life hits 0
Takes the component out of the game

outcomes: A minor enemy stands on the map
Wanders, then chases and strikes the hero
Red over the enemy, green over the hero
A hurt animation on every hit
Death animation, then gone from the game
